limitations: The exact trichotomy concerns the next-order modified-NLS Hamiltonian displayed in arXiv:2609.18170 at kappa=2, and the threshold displacement is only first-order in the nonrelativistic parameter. Derrick scaling does not by itself prove spectral or orbital stability of the full nonlinear Dirac equation. The formal large-concentration behavior of the truncated Hamiltonian is outside the controlled nonrelativistic regime. Older literature already contains pure scalar/vector correction signs and general stability caveats; residual originality risk is limited to mixed-interaction results expressed in different notation.
provenance: A source-specific correction and sharpening of the nonrelativistic Derrick calculation in arXiv:2609.18170: the nonlinear-gradient correction changes sign at p=1, yielding an exact critical-power scale-energy trichotomy and an explicit first-order p-dependent shift of the Derrick threshold.
record_title: Critical Derrick scaling reverses at p=1 in the SS+VV Dirac reduction
